purpose: Record current CASP/service context and additional researched platforms without inventing stablecoin function states that are not yet supported by scoped platform sources.

details: The 2025 Binance stablecoin policy remains useful as historical evidence of function-specific non-MiCA stablecoin restrictions.
That 2025 policy must not be presented as the complete current July 2026 EU access state because Binance did not have a MiCA licence by the end of the transition period.
Current high-quality reporting says affected EU customers are in a wind-down state rather than normal service, with selling and withdrawal/transfer actions preserved for exit management.
The article must separate Binance's 2025 stablecoin-specific restrictions from its broader 2026 CASP service interruption.

platform_context_findings.region_scope: European Union / passported EU service context
details: Financial Times identified OKX among large platforms licensed to continue serving EU customers after the July 1, 2026 transition point.
Reuters previously reported Malta's MiCA approval of OKX in the licensing rollout context.
Stablecoin-specific buy, sell, trade, deposit, withdrawal, custody, and conversion states remain unconfirmed pending scoped first-party platform sources.

platform_context_findings.region_scope: European Union / passported EU service context
details: Reuters reported that Malta had granted a MiCA licence to Crypto.com during the 2025 rollout.
A current stablecoin-specific EU/EEA function source has not yet been located.
Do not infer USDT, USDC, DAI, deposit, withdrawal, custody, or conversion availability from the licence alone.

platform_context_findings.region_scope: European Union service context; Spain launch described
details: Cinco Días reported that Bybit entered Spain after Austrian authorization and EU passporting.
The reported Spain offering included crypto buying and selling, fixed-reward products, and Bybit Card functionality.
The source does not establish stablecoin-by-stablecoin function states; those remain not confirmed.

platform_context_findings.region_scope: Cyprus authorization with listed cross-border EEA member-state services
details: CySEC lists Revolut Digital Assets (Europe) Ltd as an authorised Article 63 MiCAR CASP with registration date 2025-10-20 and licence number CASP001/25.
The register lists custody, trading-platform operation, exchange for funds, crypto-to-crypto exchange, placing, and transfer services.
The register lists cross-border services across EU/EEA member states.
This authorization evidence does not confirm the reported USDT phase-out dates, customer cohort, or automatic-conversion rule; those remain separately unresolved.

platform_context_findings.region_scope: European Union / passported EU service context
details: Cinco Días reported that Gemini obtained a MiCA licence in Malta with EU passporting scope.
Gemini is an additional researched platform beyond the initial ten-platform priority set.
Stablecoin-specific EU function states, including treatment of GUSD and third-party stablecoins, remain unresolved pending first-party platform sources.
